In any minimal absent factor avb, its interior v cannot contain two 1s (both occurring deletions would align at its unique occurrence). This exhaustively reduces to two/three-1 patterns. The exact gap and left/right zero-overhang conditions produce precisely 111,0011,1011, every 10^(d-1)1 for d not a power of two, and the two dyadic overhang families; their lengths give m(n) as claimed for all n>=2. Boundary at index zero creates 0011 and 1011. Independent literal factor-language comparison of a large prefix confirmed candidate sets at lengths 2..59; finite check is not the all-length proof.
